formal_targets.statement_text:
theorem autodischarge_003 (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.log (t ^ 2 + 1) / 2)
               (x / (x ^ 2 + 1)) x := by

Theorem coq_autodischarge_003 (x : R):
  is_derive (fun x => ln (x ^ 2 + 1) / 2) x (x / (x ^ 2 + 1)).

metadata.notes: Two independent formal kernels (Lean 4 / Mathlib + Coq / Coquelicot). lean.yml and coq.yml are the authoritative kernel checks. Lean artifact sha256=6f7c47da65a2c671…, Coq artifact sha256=46bcde078dca3856….

natural_language: The derivative identity d/dx [ln (x ^ 2 + 1) / 2] = x / (x ^ 2 + 1) is verified by two independent formal kernels with no shared trusted base: Lean 4 + Mathlib (autodischarge_003) and Coq + Coquelicot (coq_autodischarge_003). Both kernels prove the SAME statement on the SAME domain (caveat-free), so the claim is cross-verified. Neither kernel's soundness depends on the other; agreement across two distinct kernel families is the E8 guarantee.
title: Cross-prover certificate — ∫ x / (x ^ 2 + 1) dx = ln (x ^ 2 + 1) / 2
